limitations: Lexical novelty does not establish a distinct model family.
Compiler success does not establish runtime or statistical correctness.
Automatic modernization is retained with original source for review.
Repository license labels are upstream dataset metadata, not file-level legal determinations.
selection_method: Exclude local exact/token/modernized/lexical-near overlap, compiler fixtures and within-input duplicates; require data, parameters, a density-like model block referencing input, and stanc success; lexical near-dedup uses five-token Jaccard >= 0.85.
